name: meeting_transcripts
title: Meeting transcripts
description: Access your meetings: list and search them, read transcripts, and get summaries, participants, and recording links. New meetings sync automatically shortly after they end. Call meeting_transcripts("help") for a summary of all tools and their usage. Powered by Sana.ai.

tool.description: The name of the meeting transcripts tool you want to use. One of: help, login, status, list, read, search, summary, participants, recording.

args.description: An optional JSON object of arguments for the chosen tool, e.g. {"email":"you@example.com"}. Check a tool's argument schema with meeting_transcripts("help", {"tool":"<name>"}).
